description: The original Mass Mobilization codebook PDF is not present at baseline/mm_codebook.txt. Inclusion categories used here come only from the documented protocol; do not invent rules from the original manual.
required_followup: Coordinator should recover the referenced codebook through permitted means and review demand-category mapping.

description: No original ccode mapping is available in the assignment or supplied quarter files. ccode is null; no ISO code was substituted.
required_followup: Verify the original study ccode mapping before any integration.

description: The October 24 Luanda/Huambo protests are verified, but no opened source gives crowd attendance. Arrest counts include passersby, while the only roughly 2,000 estimate is a search excerpt attributing the count to Novo Jornal.
required_followup: Read an accessible contemporaneous attendance report and verify threshold separately by location.

description: Radio Angola attributes gunfire and one death to organizers; later snippets report two deaths, while Amnesty does not confirm a protester death in its October account. Arrest numbers also conflict. A state-attributed killing remains unknown.
required_followup: Seek independently reported or documentary evidence for deaths, shooter identity, injuries, detentions and state response; preserve the present uncertainty.

description: Ver Angola's 26 October article about a courthouse gathering returned HTTP 403 on the managed web open. No retry or bypass was attempted; its search excerpt alone does not show 50 participants.
required_followup: Use another permitted source to establish occurrence, attendance and response; do not revisit this URL absent a fresh access review.

description: Esquerda returned HTTP 502; News24 and DW body opens failed in the managed web tool without an HTTP status. These are technical/tool failures, not observed site denials. Their snippets remain discovery-only.
required_followup: A fresh exact-URL access check is required before any later body attempt; do not infer denial from the tool errors.

description: The inherited protocol mentions an Observador hold, but the exact historical source ledger was not supplied. The October 3 Observador result remains search-only; no publisher-wide clearance is inferred.
required_followup: Coordinator can review the original permitted ledger and exact URL/origin scope; until then do not request the Observador body.

description: Searches covered Portuguese and English and named Luanda, Huambo and other provinces, but no systematic Kimbundu, Umbundu or other Angolan-language searches or provincial radio archive searches were completed.
required_followup: Search local-language terms and provincial reporting; check separately whether the Luanda/Huambo October 24 events were coordinated.

description: Research used open web search rather than LexisNexis or equivalent systematic newspaper archives; search engines may ignore date operators and can return wrong-year results, as the October 2019 lead demonstrates.
required_followup: Review against accessible press archives and verify dates in article bodies; do not claim exhaustive coverage.

description: Search identified 12 September protests and a distinct planned 11 November protest after the 24 October events. Full prior/following unit dossiers were not available for episode-boundary review; no continuation beginning before October was confirmed.
required_followup: Compare September, November and December dossiers for distinct action, onset, closure and cross-month links; do not code the planned 11 November event as October continuity.

description: Several reports appear to use organizer statements or repeat common event facts; source independence and the exact relationship between provincial actions are not fully established.
required_followup: Record written-origin/syndication links only when explicitly documented and distinguish state-media framing from independently verified facts.
